sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory via zipfile: 'Quality Checks' row 10 / check #9; 'Internal Quality Checks' row 10 / check #9; 'Deterministic Checks' rows 2,15,17,19,23,34,39,42,48)
evidence: task/task.toml [environment]: build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 -- byte-identical to the frozen template's [environment] block and to staged-task-contract.md:56-60 (diff of task.toml vs template differs only in [task]/[metadata] identity fields). No docker_image and no allow_internet key anywhere in task.toml (grep empty), as quality-checks.md:44 and staged-task-contract.md:78 require. [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" (correct per delivery profile; not flagged). Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty): FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt ca-certificates git procps sqlite3, npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1, COPY instructions/ and assets/, git-init /app; no ENV/ARG secrets, no --platform, no bare nproc. Those two pinned packages are exactly what solution/app/package.json depends on and what integration.md tells the builder to use, so nothing secretly needs a run-time install (relevant to the stricter internal annotation). 2 CPU / 4096 MB is sane for one Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 process with a ~28.5 KB seed; solve.sh does only cp/rm plus a small node /proc scan, no native builds. Secret literals: regex scan of task.toml and everything COPYed into the image (environment/assets, environment/instructions) for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, xox*, AIza), PEM blocks, api_key/secret/token found nothing; the only credential is the demo password `Hireops!2026` at environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:11, which the skill lists as an expected known false positive. Seed emails use only reserved .example domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example); no password/hash/key/token fields in seed_data.json. task.toml's only credential is the ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template (expected). Workbook interpretation: client 'Quality Checks' row 10 says public network is correct and not to flag it; the 'Internal Quality Checks' row 10 annotation still says 'no-network' -- this is the historical annotation, superseded by the public column text and SKILL.md delivery profile, so not a defect; its other clause ('nothing that secretly needs an install') is satisfied as shown. Colderwater lessons checked: none of lessons 1-21 bear directly on agent CPU/memory/network/secret posture (lesson 13 concerns judge-prompt URLs, row 25, out of scope); no instance found in this row's files. Adversarial: a weak app cannot exploit this row (it is config-only and uses the frozen template values); a conforming app using CDN assets or public fetches is explicitly allowed by integration.md and the public network, so it cannot be failed by this posture. Limit: no agent-image build or memory-usage measurement exists in the raw-evidence index (all entries are golden verifier-image runs); the row is a static configuration check and the values are the unchanged template defaults, so this gap does not affect the verdict.
